title.narrative: Activity under preparation Promoting the digitalisation of the electricity distribution network in El Salvador

description.narrative: In line with the EU 360° approach on digital, the action aims to advance El Salvador digital transition for the electricity distribution network. This action with a pilot character will support digital technologies to manage more efficiently distribution grids. The action will also seek alignment and directly contribute to the ongoing energy digitalisation activities carried out by the EU in Central America under the GGIA flagship for the Regional Electricity Market (MER), specifically supporting the digital transformation, the technological infrastructure, and the cybersecurity strategy of the Regional Operating Entity (EOR) of the MER. As this action is expected to reduce distribution costs and improve energy efficiency, such digital solutions could be scaled up in the future by private sector operators and International Financing Institutions (IFIs). In addition, it is expected to support the government in their plan to reach universal coverage (one of the main objectives of Cuscatlán Electricity Distribution Company ¿ DEC). The European Investment Bank has already reported to be possibly interested according to first preliminary exchanges.The location of the pilot is to be defined, using the criteria of: location with average loses on distribution and poorer neighbourhoods, so end users will benefit from the improved efficiency and lower energy costs.The action also includes a digital monitoring platform (monitoring and evaluation system of the distribution network). Accurate data and characterisation of electricity demand via digital technologies should reduce reliance on fossil fuels and further integrate renewable energies in the energy mix.
